info.name: Uxio TopUp API
info.description:
Complete CRUD collection for Uxio TopUp API (Laravel 11 + Sanctum).

**Setup:**
1. Set `base_url` collection variable (default: http://localhost:8000/api/v1).
2. Run **Auth > Login** — the token is auto-captured into `{{token}}`.
3. All protected requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection.
4. Set `{{id}}` to any record ID before calling Show / Update / Delete.

**Response envelope:**
- Success: `{ status, code, message, data }`
- 422:    `{ status: "fail", code: 422, message, errors }`
- Error:  `{ status: "error", code, message, data }`

variable.description: API base URL — change to your server address
Auto-populated by the Login request test script
Set this to the record ID before calling Show / Update / Delete

item.description: Authentication endpoints. Login auto-captures the Bearer token into {{token}}.

item.name: System
item.description: Public system health endpoints — no auth required.

item.name: Users
item.description: User management CRUD. role_id must exist in the roles table.

item.name: Category Types
item.description: Master data for category type labels (e.g. Game, PPOB).

item.name: Categories
item.description: Product categories (e.g. Mobile Legends, Free Fire). `logo` is a file upload — Create and Update use multipart/form-data. `code` must be unique.

formdata.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep existing logo
Laravel method spoofing for formdata PUT

item.name: Sub-Categories
item.description: Sub-categories under a Category. `logo` is REQUIRED on Create (file upload). Uses multipart/form-data.

formdata.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep existing

item.name: Server Categories
item.description: Server selection groups for a category (e.g. 'Server' for MLBB).

item.name: Server Category Options
item.description: Individual dropdown options within a server category (e.g. 'Asia', 'Europe').

item.name: Suppliers
item.description: Product supplier master data (e.g. Digiflazz).

item.name: Supplier Categories
item.description: Links a Supplier to a Category with a Digiflazz template_code.

item.name: Products
item.description: Products for sale. Five price tiers: modal, member, vip, reseller, agent. `code` must be unique.

item.name: Supplier Products
item.description: Maps a Product to a Supplier SKU (buyer_sku_code from Digiflazz). `is_active` gates checkout eligibility.

item.name: Transactions
item.description: Transaction records. Status machine: PENDING → PAID → PROCESSING → COMPLETED / FAILED_PROVIDER. `invoice_number` is the Digiflazz ref_id. `user_id` is nullable for guest checkouts.

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payment records linked to Transactions. Status: '1'=Pending, '2'=Expired/Failed, '3'=Success, '4'=Refunded.

item.name: Point Histories
item.description: Point ledger records per user transaction.

item.name: Ratings
item.description: User ratings for transactions. Rating value: 1–5.

item.name: Banners
item.description: CMS banner images. `image_path` is REQUIRED on Create (file upload). Uses multipart/form-data.

formdata.description: Optional. exists:categories,id. Leave empty for global banner.
Optional. Leave empty to keep existing image
Laravel method spoofing for formdata PUT

item.name: Announcements
item.description: CMS announcements. Optional image_path file upload. is_active defaults to true.

formdata.description: Optional. Leave empty for global announcement.

formdata.value: Maintenance scheduled for tonight at 11 PM.

formdata.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep existing
Laravel method spoofing for formdata PUT

item.name: Activity Logs
item.description: Read-only audit log of user activity.

item.name: Leaderboard
item.description: Read-only top user leaderboard.

item.name: Checkout
item.description: Public endpoint — no auth required. Initiates a top-up order and returns QRIS or Virtual Account payment data. For guests, provide guest_contact (WhatsApp number).

item.name: _Webhooks (Reference Only)
item.description: These endpoints are called BY Monetapay and Digiflazz servers, not by the frontend. Included here for debugging/testing only.
